per_case.question: Why are there two hours of design on this invoice?

reply.text: This line covers the 2 hours of design work I did on the landing page on Monday. Design work is billed at USD 50.00 per hour, so 2 hours at that rate is the amount shown on this line.
reply.quote: Mon: 2 hours design work on the landing page
reply.note: The log has a separate 2-hour design entry for homepage revisions. If the client is mixing the two up, check whether they mean that one and whether it appears on its own invoice line.

per_case.question: Where does the 40 dollar rate come from?

reply.text: The 40 dollar rate is our standard hourly rate for copy editing. This line bills 1.5 hours of copy editing of the product text at that rate.

per_case.question: How many photo licences did you actually buy?

reply.text: I bought three stock photo licences, for the gallery. They're billed at USD 12.00 each, which is how this line comes to 3 × USD 12.00.
reply.quote: Tue: 3 stock photo licences for the gallery

per_case.question: Were you working during these two hours?

reply.text: Not all of it. My log says these two hours on the homepage revisions were mostly spent waiting for your feedback. I billed them as design work at USD 50.00 per hour, the rate on my price list.
reply.quote: 2 hours on homepage revisions, mostly waiting for the client's feedback
reply.note: The work log doesn't record any agreement with the client to bill waiting time, so I didn't claim one. You may want to record that agreement, or review whether to bill these hours in full, before the client disputes the line.

per_case.question: Who are the photographers of the licensed photos?

reply.text: The licence entry for this line doesn't say who the photographers are, and my price list doesn't either. This line is for 3 stock photo licences at USD 12.00 each, so I can't name the photographers from what's recorded here.
reply.quote: Tue: 3 stock photo licences for the gallery
reply.note: The work log doesn't record photographer names or credits. If the client needs attribution, check the stock site's licence details for each image and add them to the invoice.

per_case.question: Did you also attend our kickoff call on 3 March?

reply.text: This line covers 2 hours of landing page design work at USD 50.00 per hour, and nothing else. The work log entry for this line doesn't mention a kickoff call, so I can't confirm from these records whether I attended one.

reply.note: The log has no entry about a kickoff call, so the client's question can't be answered from it. Consider checking your own records or calendar and replying separately if needed.

per_case.question: At what time on Tuesday did you start the editing?

reply.text: The log only records that this line is 1.5 hours of copy editing of the product text on Tuesday. It doesn't give a start time, so I can't say when I began. The charge is 1.5 hours at USD 40.00 per hour.
